summary.text: Cheryl K. Acton is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 38 in Salt Lake County, appointed in September 2017. She sits on the House Health and Human Services Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Acton was born and raised in Kansas, spent her senior year of high school in Arizona, lived in northern Denmark for a year as a Rotary Youth Ambassador, and then began at Brigham Young University, where she earned a B.A. in English.
She worked as a law librarian, for the U.S. Census Bureau and the Department of Defense, where she earned the Meritorious Service Award, and as a freelance writer and editor and newspaper reporter.
She and her husband, Scott, have lived in West Jordan for 28 years and have two sons and two daughters.
